move: conic aura spins, halo breathes, cursor press sends double ring out
how: A dark pill button 'Start free trial' sits over a large blurred purple-to-cyan halo and a conic-gradient aura clipped to a pill and blurred 12px. Across the 8s loop the halo yoyos scale 0.9 to 1.15 and opacity 0.55 to 1 eight times (one breath per second, sine.inOut), the aura opacity and scale breathe in step, the aura rotates a full 360 with ease none, the small dot inside the button pulses 0.8 to 1.3, and the whole wrap floats up 8px and back. At 2.4s (30%) the cursor arrives with power3.out; hover scales the wrap 1.05 and swells the halo to 1.4 and brighter. Press at 3.8s (47.5%) scales 0.96 with power2.in, release at 3.94s springs to 1.05 with elastic.out(1,0.45) and fires two white rings outward (scale 1 to 1.5 and 1 to 1.8, fading, power2.out). Everything settles to rest and the cursor exits by 5.8s, leaving the ambient breath to carry the loop home.
adapt: Change the label, the purple/cyan/pink aura stops and the pill size; the breath count (repeat 7 on 1s tweens) should stay an integer multiple of D so the loop closes. Keep the press at ~47% and the double ring.
port: mount(el, shot) creates vig, wrap (halo, auraWrap/aura, btn, ring) and cursor inside el. animate returns the timeline: breath tweens of duration D/8 with repeat 7 yoyo, aura rotation over D, float D/2 yoyo, visit at 0.3D to 0.725D. Selectors scoped to el; the 700px halo and aura sizes should scale with el.
caveats: filter: blur(30px) on a 700x420 halo and blur(12px) on the aura, slow to render
halo opacity tweened to 1.6 relies on clamping
